roots.core_concept: to feel, to perceive / 感到、察觉到
roots.core_image: 手伸进水里，先感到的是凉

roots.core_concept: to leap / 跳起来、蹦出去
roots.core_image: 蚂蚱一蹬腿从草丛里蹦出来

roots.core_concept: to take counsel / 找人商量、请教
roots.core_image: 把事摊在桌上，请对面的人给个说法

roots.core_concept: to cut apart / 切开、分成段
roots.core_image: 刀落下去，整块东西成了两段

concepts.core_image: 手伸进水里，先感到的是凉
蚂蚱一蹬腿从草丛里蹦出来
把事摊在桌上，请对面的人给个说法
刀落下去，整块东西成了两段

words.root_logic: sentire（感觉）本身即词根，无词缀 → 感受这件事，以及由此得出的判断
words.recall_hint: sentire（感觉）本身即词根 → 感受这件事本身；引申为由感受得出的判断力，或一段话说得通的那个意思
words.native_definition: any of the faculties of perception, good judgement, or the meaning of something
words.core_concept: what one perceives, and what one makes of it – 感到什么，以及由此判定什么
words.core_image: 手伸进水里先感到凉，接着判断这水不能洗手
examples: She lost her sense of smell.
He had the sense to stop early.
That sentence makes no sense.
semantic_expansions: 感觉：感官所感到的
判断力：由感受得出的分辨能力
意义：一段话能被感知、说得通的那个内容。三义共享'感到并由此明白'

words.root_logic: sens（感觉、判断）+ -ible（能…的）→ 能凭感受作出判断的 → 明智的
words.native_definition: showing good judgement; practical rather than emotional
words.core_concept: guided by sound perception – 凭得住的感受与判断行事
words.core_image: 下雨前先带伞的人，不必等淋了才想起来
examples: That is a sensible precaution.
Wear sensible shoes for the hike.
semantic_expansions: 明智的/合情理的：判断凭得住
切合实际的（鞋）：以实用而非好看为准。同一个'凭感受与判断行事'，一个说人一个说物

words.root_logic: sens（感觉）+ -ation（名词）→ 被感到的那一下；引申为让所有人都感到的那件事 → 轰动
words.recall_hint: sens（感觉）+ -ation → 身上被感到的那一下；放大到人群，就是让所有人都感到的那件事
words.native_definition: a physical feeling, or great excitement among many people
words.core_concept: something felt, whether in the body or by a crowd – 被感到的那一下，落在身上或人群里
words.core_image: 指尖麻了一下；消息传开时整条街都在议论
examples: A burning sensation spread up his arm.
Her debut caused a sensation.
semantic_expansions: 感觉/知觉：身上被感到的那一下
轰动：让整群人同时感到的那件事。同一个'被感到'，范围从一人到一群

words.root_logic: sent（感觉、判定）+ -ence（名词）→ 表达一个完整判断的那串话 → 句子；法官作出的判定 → 判决
words.recall_hint: sent（感觉、判定）+ -ence → 承载一个完整判断的那串话；在法庭上则是法官作出的那个判定
words.origin: 拉丁语 sententia：sentire（感觉、判断）——'所持的意见'
words.native_definition: a group of words expressing a complete thought, or a punishment decided by a court
words.core_concept: a completed judgement put into words – 被说成话的一个完整判断
words.core_image: 写满一行字后落下句号，意思到此完整了
examples: Read the second sentence again.
He received a five-year sentence.
semantic_expansions: 句子：承载一个完整判断的那串话
判决/宣判：法官所作的那个判定。同一个'成形的判断'，一个在语言一个在法庭

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ sent（感觉、想）→ 双方所感相同 → 同意
words.origin: 拉丁语 consentire：com-（一起）+ sentire（感觉）——'同感'
words.native_definition: permission or agreement for something to happen
words.core_concept: feeling the same way as the other – 与对方所感一致
words.core_image: 两人对看一眼同时点头，不必再说什么
examples: The patient gave written consent.
She consented to the interview.
semantic_expansions: 同意/赞同：与对方所感一致
许可：因所感一致而放行。同一个'同感'，一个是态度一个是授权

words.root_logic: re-（回、随之）+ sult（跳）→ 事情之后蹦出来的那个 → 结果
words.origin: 拉丁语 resultare：re-（回）+ salire（跳）——'反弹回来'
words.native_definition: something that happens because of an action or event
words.core_concept: what leaps back out of what was done – 做完之后蹦出来的那个东西
words.core_image: 球砸在墙上，弹回来的那一下就是它
examples: The result was announced at noon.
Careless work results in errors.
semantic_expansions: 结果/成绩：事后蹦出来的那个
导致（动词）：使那个东西蹦出来。同一个'随之弹出'，一个是所得一个是致因

words.root_logic: in-（朝…上）+ sult（跳）→ 跳到别人身上去踩 → 侮辱
words.origin: 拉丁语 insultare：in-（朝上）+ salire（跳）——'跳到人身上'
words.native_definition: to say or do something offensive to someone
words.core_concept: leaping onto someone to trample them – 跳到对方身上去踩
words.core_image: 对方已经跌倒了，还上去踩一脚
examples: He insulted her in front of everyone.
The remark was a deliberate insult.
semantic_expansions: 侮辱/辱骂/冒犯：都是'跳到人身上去踩'，中文按方式与轻重分了三个词

words.root_logic: consulere（商议）本身即词根，无额外前缀 → 把事拿去请人给个说法
words.recall_hint: consulere（商议、求教）本身即词根 → 把事拿去请人给个说法；也用于查阅资料，向书求教
words.origin: 拉丁语 consultare：consulere（商议、求教）的反复形
words.native_definition: to ask someone for advice or information, or to look something up
words.core_concept: taking a matter to someone for their view – 把事拿去请对方给个说法
words.core_image: 拿着病历坐到医生对面，等他说该怎么办
examples: You should consult a lawyer first.
She consulted the timetable again.
semantic_expansions: 咨询/请教：拿事去请人给说法
查阅（资料）：拿事去向书本求答案。同一个'求个说法'，求于人还是于书

words.root_logic: consult（请人给说法）+ -ant（人）→ 专供人请教的那个人 → 顾问
words.native_definition: an expert who gives professional advice, or a senior hospital doctor
words.core_concept: the one people bring matters to – 专门被拿事去请教的那个人
words.core_image: 会议室里那个不属于本公司的人，专门被请来给意见
examples: They hired a tax consultant.
The consultant will see you now.
semantic_expansions: 顾问/咨询师：专供人请教的人
主任医师（英式）：科室里被请去定夺的那位。同一个'被请教者'，行业不同

words.root_logic: sect（切）+ -or（物）→ 被切出来的那一块 → 部门、扇形
words.recall_hint: sect（切）+ -or → 从整体上切出来的那一块：可以是经济中的一块，也可以是圆里的一瓣
words.native_definition: a part of an economy or society, or a part of a circle between two radii
words.core_concept: a piece cut out of a whole – 从整体上切下来的那一块
words.core_image: 圆饼从圆心切两刀，取出中间那一瓣
examples: The public sector employs millions.
Shade the sector between the two radii.
semantic_expansions: 部门/行业：从整体经济上切出的一块
扇形：从圆上切出的一瓣。同一个'切出的一块'，切的是社会还是圆

words.root_logic: sect（切）+ -ion（名词）→ 切开所得的那一段，或切开这件事 → 部分、剖面
words.recall_hint: sect（切）+ -ion → 切开所得的那一段；也指把东西切开看到的那个面
words.native_definition: one of the parts something is divided into, or a view of something cut through
words.core_concept: what a cut produces – 切开之后所得的那一段或那个面
words.core_image: 树干横锯一刀，年轮全露在切面上
examples: Read the final section carefully.
The diagram shows a cross section.
semantic_expansions: 部分/章节：切开所得的那一段
剖面：切开后露出的那个面。同一个'切'，一个看段落一个看断面

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ sect（切）→ 身上像被切出几道口子的那种动物 → 昆虫
words.origin: 拉丁语 insectum：in-（进入）+ secare（切）——'身体有切痕的'
words.native_definition: a small animal with six legs and a body divided into three parts
words.core_concept: a creature whose body looks cut into segments – 身体像被切成几节的那种小动物
words.core_image: 蚂蚁的腰细成一线，前后像是两截接起来的
examples: Bees are social insects.
The garden is full of insects in June.

words.root_logic: inter-（之间、互相）+ sect（切）+ -ion → 两者互切所得的那一点 → 交叉口
words.origin: 拉丁语 intersectio：inter-（之间）+ secare（切）
words.native_definition: a place where two roads or lines cross
words.core_concept: where two things cut across each other – 两者互相切过的那一处
words.core_image: 两条路交叉的那个方块，四个方向都通
examples: Turn left at the next intersection.
The intersection of the two sets is empty.
semantic_expansions: 交叉口/十字路口：两条路互切的那一处
交集（数学）：两个集合互切所得的部分。同一个'互相切过'，切的是路还是集合

words.root_logic: seg（sec 的变体，切）+ -ment（结果）→ 被切下来的那一节 → 部分
words.native_definition: one of the parts into which something is divided
words.core_concept: one piece cut off the whole – 从整体上切下来的一节
words.core_image: 橘子剥开，一瓣一瓣界限分明
examples: Divide the line into three segments.
This segment of the market is growing.
semantic_expansions: 部分/节：从整体上切下的一段
瓣（果实）：天然分界的那一节。同一个'切下的一节'，人为切还是天生分

words.root_logic: re-（反过来）+ sent（感觉）→ 心里对某事生出反感 → 怨恨
words.origin: 拉丁语 re-（反）+ sentire（感觉）经法语 ressentir
words.native_definition: to feel bitter about something you think is unfair
words.core_concept: feeling back against something – 心里朝那件事生出反感
words.core_image: 话早过去了，一想起来胸口还是堵
examples: She resented being left out.
He resents any criticism.
semantic_expansions: 怨恨/愤恨/不满：都是'心里朝那件事生出反感'，中文按强度分了三个词
